comment: test-health-1 — e2e checks that run but do not gate (scripts/ci/quarantine.cjs; the battery reports them in their own tier). perf/budgets.json "allow" one domain over: suite + optionally ONE check (a substring of its FAIL label; absent = the whole suite), why, who owns the fix, since, review. A suite red is non-blocking only when EVERY failed check matches an entry (a crash or timeout never is, unless the whole suite is listed). Past-review and now-green entries print as warnings. Remove an entry in the PR that fixes it.

quarantine.check: B renders a lock highlight box
quarantine.reason: load-sensitive: the Approve toast click is intercepted by the canvas and the toast detaches; green in a quiet slot (75 s vs 131-136 s red), red on v1.42.0 in the same place (57-union, 65-union)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: incoming toasts never shift it
quarantine.reason: the toast burst moves the spectator 8 px under load (a fixed sleep); a different row red each run, pristine v1.41.0 3/3 red (50-int r4)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: the Roughness readout shows the material
quarantine.reason: read before the Inspector re-renders under load (fixed sleep); red on pristine v1.41.0 (50-int r4)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: it hides after the grace period
quarantine.reason: fixed-sleep grace window vs load (50-int r3)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: after Accept the peer has the checkpoint
quarantine.reason: two-peer timing; red on the union AND pristine v1.41.0, green in r4 (50-int, 50-window)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: and so does the host
quarantine.reason: flips run to run with the row above (green r1, red r3; 50-int)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: an autosave write cuts an automatic row
quarantine.reason: the automatic row lands ~15.7 s, the check waits 12 s (50-window)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 1.4 no long task over
quarantine.reason: a 204-389 ms long task vs the 200 ms line under load; known in 39/40/41/42 incl. A/B bases (L3)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 6.3 no long task over
quarantine.reason: as 1.4, while restoring; the one L3 row red on preview-1-42 (50-int)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 4.4 a toast says the load was stopped
quarantine.reason: the toast is read after it expired under load (49-int x1, 50-int)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: C received the scene
quarantine.reason: third peer handshake timing; red on pristine v1.41.0 and on 904599c1 (50-int r3, 55-invite)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 2.1 mode 'continuous' KEEPS pushing
quarantine.reason: body at 0 m/s under a held key on a slow frame; flaky in every app x driver cell (deps-1 ab3)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 4.3 read 'speed' reports real motion
quarantine.reason: as 2.1 (deps-1 ab3)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 6.5 (premise) the trigger hops the box
quarantine.reason: two-peer world timing (deps-1 ab3, 49-int)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 8.5 and the very NEXT press throws the box
quarantine.reason: stale-press guard vs frame timing (pcA, deps-1)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: G4 (near) a finger on the crate takes it
quarantine.reason: G4 flick timing: 12/12 green on --local, red under load (deps-1 ab3)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 1.3 standing: B's lowest sole is on the floor
quarantine.reason: red 2/4 d3d12, 3/3 llvmpipe, green on rerun (mux-pc-host)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 2.1 every fallback group built its PACK model
quarantine.reason: 1 red in 3 on each GPU path: pack fetch vs the wait (mux-pc-host)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 2.2 every group DRAWS a pack level
quarantine.reason: as 2.1 (mux-pc-host)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 2.12 within 60 ms B's rendered ball has moved
quarantine.reason: a 60 ms window on a remote frame; pc rerun 3/3 green (mux-pc-host)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 7.2 OPEN: the capsule walks through the doorway
quarantine.reason: a fixed 300 ms wait vs charController's lazy physics import; base 1/3 red (59-replace)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: Save as file binds the node
quarantine.reason: a 2000 ms wait; flaked on both base and lane (50-yjs, 50-window)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: so the door closes rather than restarting
quarantine.reason: ~1.7 fps under load: a 900 ms window holds 1-2 frames; 35/0 on a GPU slot (57-clips)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: 6.3 opening an Explorer image brings the docked editor forward
quarantine.reason: red 1/2 on both 1.41 and 1.40 production, green on base in deps-1 ab1 (53-int)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)

quarantine.check: I9: each corner shows ONE
quarantine.reason: known deployed flake (touch reorder, unfolded dark); same 2 reds on production 1.39 (49-int, 53-int)
quarantine.owner: test-health (standing lane)
